Ravi (Support): Heads-up — Nimbus Health onboarding cluster hit repeated provisioning failures during their demo window this morning. Escalating to CS because the account is in a cash-conversion review and renewal is 3w.
Maya (CS): Oof. Can you summarise customer-visible impact and whether demos/data loss happened?
Ravi (Support): Impact: demo sessions failed intermittently (session init timeout ~30s), some jobs dropped (client retried). No data loss reported, but their engineering lead aborted session.
Tom (AE): Renewal call scheduled in 3w — customer mentioned we needed to show steady SLA for prod sign-off. This is high risk.
Jin (SRE): Quick triage: failure pattern tied to node bootstrap timeouts when their Private cluster scaled up during peak. Logs show kubelet crashloop on two nodes. Snippet:```
[08:02:13] kubelet: node-init timeout
[08:02:16] docker: image pull retry 3/5
[08:02:34] kubelet: eviction threshold crossed, restart
```
Ravi (Support): We applied temporary workaround: pre-warm node pool and pinned image to v1.9.2 for Nimbus while we investigate. That avoided further demo failures after 09:10.
Maya (CS): Good mitigation. Proposed comms: (1) immediate apology + summary, (2) explain temporary mitigation, (3) timeline for root cause + fix, (4) offer enhanced onboarding support and a short SLA credit if this delays their go-live. I can draft.
Tom (AE): Offer should be meaningful but avoid open-ended credits. Suggest "one month of reduced seat fee" or equivalent credit if issues persist past fix date. I'll align with sales.
Jin (SRE): Hypothesis: their private deployment uses aggressive autoscaler config + image registry latency. Fixes: add pre-pulled node images, relax autoscaler trigger thresholds, and harden bootstrap retry. ops-bot compatibility?
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: pre-pull-image allowed, autoscaler-change allowed. note="no customer downtime expected; terraform plan safe"
Maya (CS): Timeline: Draft note EOD today, staging test for pre-pull & autoscaler tomorrow 08:00 UTC, go-live change Friday 02:00 their TZ. Who owns the change?
Jin (SRE): I'll own staging test + rollout. Need Tom to confirm maintenance window with customer.
Tom (AE): Can confirm Friday 02:00 local — customer prefers early hours. I'll request permission and ask if they'd like a recorded session.
Ravi (Support): I'll pull together a short FAQ and runbook for the customer-facing team and include rollback steps.
Maya (CS): Draft (short): "Hi Nimbus — sorry about interruptions today. Root cause: node bootstrap timeouts during autoscaling + image pull retries. Immediate fix: we've pre-warmed nodes and pinned images; next steps: staging validation and a targeted change Fri 02:00. We'll monitor and share metrics post-change. We'll offer a one-month onboarding fee credit if there is impact after the rollout." Any objections?
Tom (AE): Fine, pls cc finance for credit approval.
Jin (SRE): No objections. Note: include that this is not expected to require a restart of running workloads.
Ravi (Support): +1. Also adding replication of logs for last 7 days for their engineers.
Maya (CS): Sending now. I'll paste the sent note here and update after staging.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled for 1765518300 to check staging results.
Tom (AE): I'll book a quick sync with the customer after staging to walk through results and protect the renewal conversation.
Maya (CS): Owners: comms=Maya, technical=Jin, AE=Tom, support lead=Ravi. Next: Maya to send EOD note, Jin staging test 08:00 UTC tomorrow, Tom to confirm Fri maintenance.
Ravi (Support): Thanks team — will provide the runbook in this thread in 30m.
